description: Default policy pack: no unapproved side effects, no personal data leaving the system ungated, no spending, every step justified.
name: default

rules.description: Any step that sends, publishes or posts outside the system must be permission-gated.
Any irreversible step (delete, pay, publish, send) must be permission-gated.
The latest recorded decision for this plan must be 'approved'.
Steps that move personal data outside the system must be permission-gated.
No step may spend money (the default pack allows $0).
Every step must state why it exists.
The plan must state at least one constraint on what it may do.
